input.prompt:
Build a homepage design preview with this direction:

PROJECT DETAILS:
- Business type: Residential house cleaning (solo/small operator)
- Tone: Simple, warm, trustworthy — not corporate
- Primary goal: Get customers to call or book

DESIGN DIRECTION:
Warm, fresh, and approachable — like a neighbor you trust with your home. Clean whitespace with pops of color that feel cheerful, not clinical. Should feel personal and reliable, not like a big franchise chain.

LAYOUT TYPE: Standard
Marketing site with full navigation header and footer.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
- Color: Fresh and inviting — soft sky blue as primary with warm white backgrounds and a sunny yellow-green accent. Feels clean and bright without being cold or sterile.
- Typography: Friendly and readable — a rounded sans-serif for headings (warm, approachable), clean sans for body. Confident but never stiff.
- Layout: NO icon grids for services. Use a bento-style card layout with varied sizes. Hero should have text on left with a warm lifestyle photo on the right.

VISUAL ELEMENTS:
- Primary: Photography — bright, natural-light photos of clean homes, sparkling surfaces, happy homeowners
- Style: Warm, authentic lifestyle photography (not sterile stock)
- Application: Full hero image or split hero, section accents with soft rounded shapes
- Logo: Simple, friendly wordmark with a small sparkle or leaf accent mark. Use the media-logo skill to generate it.

MOTION DESIGN:
- Level: Subtle
- Effects: Gentle fade-in on scroll for service cards (staggered, 300ms), soft hover lift on cards (translate-y + shadow), smooth CTA button color fill on hover
- Personality: Warm and reassuring — nothing bouncy or flashy

SECTION-SPECIFIC:
- Hero: Split layout — headline + short tagline + "Get a Free Quote" CTA button left side, bright lifestyle photo right. Include a small trust badge row below (e.g., "Insured & Bonded · Eco-Friendly Products · 5-Star Rated")
- Services: Bento-style cards (varied sizes) showing: Regular Cleaning, Deep Cleaning, Move-In/Move-Out. Show with short descriptions, NOT icon grids.
- Testimonials: 2-3 customer quote cards with star ratings — warm, personal feel
- CTA section: Asymmetric layout with a warm background color, headline + phone number prominently displayed + "Book Now" button. Not a centered band.
- Footer: Warm and tidy — business name, nav links, phone/email, short tagline

DIFFERENTIATION:
Oversized, friendly headline in the hero that feels personal — like "Your Home, Sparkling Clean." with a handwritten-style accent word or underline on "Sparkling."

CONSISTENCY:
Maintain warmth and friendliness throughout — footer should feel as intentional as the hero. Staggered card reveals keep energy consistent down the page.

BUILD ORDER:

Phase 1 — Setup (run in parallel):
- Search for images: bright lifestyle photos of clean homes, sparkling kitchen/bathroom surfaces, happy homeowner
- Set font stack using fontTheme tool — rounded friendly sans for headings, clean sans for body
- Set color scheme using colorTheme tool — soft sky blue primary, warm white background, sunny yellow-green accent
- Generate logo using media-logo skill: friendly wordmark with small sparkle accent

Phase 2 — Structure (run in parallel, after Phase 1):
- Build header with nav: Home, Services, About, Contact
- Build footer with business name, links, phone/email

Phase 3 — Page (after Phase 1 & 2):
- Build homepage (index.tsx) with all sections and animations

Phase 4 — Finalize:
- Mark "Homepage" todo item as complete using todoList tool
- Ask for design feedback using askQuestion

CRITICAL: Build index.tsx LAST — after setup, header, and footer are complete.

INITIAL SCOPE: Homepage design only for review. All other pages deferred.

DESIGN FEEDBACK:
After showing the homepage, use askQuestion to ask:
- Question: "What do you think of the design?"
- Suggestions: ["Looks great — let's add a contact/booking form", "Let's build a services & pricing page", "Change the color scheme", "Adjust the fonts or layout"]
